description: Deployments: every deploy to any environment — record, list, environments, for_ticket, running, watch

methods.name: record
methods.description: Record a deployment (DEPLOY-10's record): the tickets its commits carry run in the environment; yields deployed { deployment, carried, unlinked, entered, left, duplicate }
methods.long_description:
Records one deployment — DEPLOY-10's record, its fields as the
parameters (`deploy/record --send` passes the record whole as the
params object). `project` is a shortcode the store holds, any case;
`environment` a name (kept lower case); `state` one of `started`,
`succeeded`, `failed`, `rolled_back`; `revision` the commit now
running (for `failed`, the one tried; for `rolled_back`, the one
returned to — `previous` the one taken out); `commits` the range it
carries, when the CI can list them; `tickets` ids it names itself.
The tickets whose linked commits are among `commits` and `revision`,
plus `tickets`, run in the environment from `at` once it succeeds; a
rollback, or a later deploy to an older revision, takes out what only
the undone deploys carried; `started` and `failed` count for nothing.
A deployment never changes a status. Yields exactly one event:
`deployed` — the deployment as kept, the tickets it carried, its
commits no ticket links, and the tickets that `entered` and `left`
the environment; `duplicate: true` and nothing written when the same
record (project, environment, state, revision, and `source.run`,
else `at`) is kept already — or an in-band `error` naming every
problem, with nothing kept.

DeploySource.description: Where to read the run that made a deployment.

run.description: Its run, as the CI names it — what a retry of the same record repeats.

at.description: When: RFC 3339 or unix seconds (optional; default now)

commits.description: Every commit in previous..revision, when the CI can list them (optional)

environment.description: Its name: test, staging, prod, pr-412 …

previous.description: The commit that ran before (rolled_back: the one taken out) (optional)

project.description: Whose environment: a shortcode, any case (menger is MENGER)

revision.description: The commit now running (rolled_back: the one returned to; failed: the one tried); repo@sha outside the project's repository

source.description: Where to read the run: { system, run, url } (optional; run makes a retry one deployment)

tickets.description: Ticket ids the CI names itself, added to what the commits give (optional)

methods.name: list
methods.description: List deployments newest first, by project, environment, state and ticket; each with the tickets it carried
methods.long_description:
The deployments matching every filter given, newest first — one
`deployment` event each (with the tickets it carried, its unlinked
commits, and `live`: whether it still counts in its environment) —
then exactly one `page { next }`. `after` starts strictly after
(older than) that deployment; `limit` caps the page. From the cache.

after.description: Cursor: start strictly after (older than) this deployment id (optional)

limit.description: At most this many; the page event carries the next cursor (optional)

state.description: Only in this state: started | succeeded | failed | rolled_back (optional)

ticket.description: Only those that carried this ticket (optional)

methods.name: environments
methods.description: Each environment: what it runs, since when, its last deployment, how many tickets run there
methods.long_description:
Every environment — of `project` when given — one `environment`
event each, by project and then in display order (test → staging →
prod): what it runs, since when, its last deployment, and how many
tickets run there.
